references.text: The sons of Zebulun mentioned here are Sered, Elon and Jahleel, who are the ancestors of the clans counted in Numbers 26:27
The first census of the tribe of Zebulun showed 57,400 men, which can be compared with the 60,500 in the second count
The location of the tribe of Zebulun in the camp and their first census are mentioned here
Moses' blessing over the tribe of Zebulun that was counted in Numbers 26:27
The territory assigned to the tribe of Zebulun during the division of Canaan
